Everyone sees the same secret word except one. Give clues, then find the imposter.
Phone on your forehead. Your team acts it out. Guess as many as you can in 60 seconds.
Find the animals two by two. Made for children, fun for everyone.
Play a Bible story as an animated storybook. Answer as it unfolds, and the story keeps going.
